correctness.rationale: Exact Minkowski support-sum identity gives a shifted independent Rademacher expression for all unit directions. Gaussian smoothing with a uniform third-derivative bound and termwise third-moment Lindeberg replacement proves an explicit absolute-cube error bound; its smallness for Haar directions uses the Gaussian/spherical maximum-coordinate estimate. The diagonal projection converges by Gaussian radial normalization, all positive moments by uniform spherical moments, and the limiting variance by a standard bivariate-normal absolute-product identity. Binomial square-root and Gamma-ratio expansions produce the sharp 1/(8d) spherical-mean correction. Standalone standard-library checker verifies 42 exact low-dimensional cube-corner optimizations and finite spherical moments through d=64; it is corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The White Whale is a natural, specifically studied exponential-generator zonotope whose resonance arrangement creates an enormous combinatorial barrier to vertex enumeration. The theorem provides a nontrivial all-dimensional Euclidean invariant: asymptotic one-dimensional sufficiency of its width functional, exact positive limiting width variance, non-Gaussian distribution, and a sharp next-order spherical mean correction. It is not solely a sample computation or a known finite face table; its geometric interpretation distinguishes exponential generator complexity from angular concentration.
